_comment: Rainfall analysis windows. PROPOSED values: event windows come from the project's own settings.json approx_period and the Sentinel-1 candidate dates; they are NOT verified rainfall facts. Confirm with Agent 1 before interpreting. Never reuse the 2023 sample for 2015.

2015_nov_dec.name: Chennai 2015 Nov-Dec rainfall episodes
2015_nov_dec.context_window_reason: inclusive dates; 21 Jul is 30 days before the 20 Aug Sentinel-1 candidate (30-day antecedent window = 21 Jul..19 Aug, reference day excluded); ends 20 Dec after the 18 Dec candidate

2021_sep_nov.name: Chennai 2021 Sep-Nov rainfall context for the eight processed Sentinel-1 dates
2021_sep_nov.context_window_reason: inclusive dates (115 days); 6 Aug is 30 days before the first Sentinel-1 date 2021-09-05 (30-day antecedent window = 6 Aug..4 Sep, reference day excluded); ends on the last Sentinel-1 date 2021-11-28
2021_sep_nov.event_window_source: span of the eight Sentinel-1 dates in config/s1_preprocess.json (a context span, NOT a verified flood-event window)
